body:
_Migrated from issue #1017, filed 2026-07-20._

Found while shipping #875 / #1016.

`Integration Tests (Docker)` in `.github/workflows/tests.yml` runs on pushes to `main`/`dev`, on manual dispatch, or on a PR labeled `safe-tier-2` — and nowhere else. So a PR that changes **only the Dockerfile**, the one file whose whole job is producing a working image, gets `skipping` on the only job that builds and boots one.

#1016 is the concrete case: a `RUN` stanza that creates Calibre's `/usr/bin` symlinks at build time. Every check on it was green with the image never having been built. I built and cold-booted it by hand and it was fine, but "a maintainer remembered to" is not a gate.

The tier-2 label is the wrong proxy here. A Dockerfile / `root/etc/s6-overlay/**` / `scripts/setup-cwa.sh` change is exactly the class that needs the container built, whatever its size.

Suggested: extend the `if:` to also fire when the PR touches image-build inputs — `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`, `root/**`, `requirements*.txt` — via a paths-filter step whose output feeds the condition. Keep `continue-on-error` semantics as they are today so this doesn't become a new flake source; make it gating only where tier-2 already is.

Worth checking at the same time whether `E2E Tests (SPA)` has the mirror-image gap for `frontend/**`.
title: CI: a Dockerfile-only PR doesn't run the Docker integration tests
